messages:
zoe: New draft for the Product Launch post (Optimize) uploaded. Main asks: 1) pick CTA (webinar vs gated benchmark) 2) confirm benchmark wording 3) HubSpot routing naming. Quick eyes pls. :eyes:

elaine: I lean webinar-first for this audience, but we should surface a gated benchmark link in the sidebar for deeper leads. Can we map both CTAs to different HubSpot lists?

sanjay: Yep. Proposed split: CTA A (Register Webinar) -> list: Launch - Optimize - Webinar; CTA B (Download Benchmark) -> list: Launch - Optimize - Benchmark. Webinar gets nurture sequence, gated gets immediate SDR tag if company_size > 100.

maria: Legal note: don't use absolutes. Replace "we cut costs 50%" with "in our benchmarks, costs were reduced by up to 50%" and include appendix with test rig (model, seq len, GPU). I'll quick-pass after appendix is attached.

zoe: Edited hero stat per legal. New hero: "In our benchmark tests, Optimize reduced per-token inference cost by up to 50% while increasing throughput up to 3.1x." Pushed update.

sanjay: HubSpot naming suggestion for ops template: Workflow: Launch - Optimize - Blog CTA - Webinar; Workflow: Launch - Optimize - Blog CTA - Benchmark. UTM pattern: utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content={webinar|benchmark}.

ops-bot: Publish checklist: copy locked, legal signoff pending, hero image pending, HubSpot workflows created (staged).

elaine: I'll attach appendix and finalize hero image with Nora. Plan to publish Tue 09:00 PT if Maria gives legal OK by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Will review appendix tonight and post sign-off in this thread. :white_check_mark:
